```{ojs}
S0 = FileAttachment("../data/states.csv").csv({typed: true})
IDX = FileAttachment("../data/inst_index.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
S = S0.map(d => ({...d, dpk: d.pk_2024 - d.pk_2012, dpkw: d.pkw_2024 - d.pkw_2012, ddual: d.dual_2023 - d.dual_2013,
  ...Object.fromEntries(["fac", "nonfac", "allx"].flatMap(p => [[`${p}_dpk`, d[`${p}_pk_2024`] - d[`${p}_pk_2013`]], [`${p}_dpkw`, d[`${p}_pkw_2024`] - d[`${p}_pkw_2013`]]]))}))
// staff measures on this page: FTE measures from FY2013 (first year of the redesigned staff survey); v1 headcount from FY2012
SPRE = ({facfte: "fac", nonfacfte: "nonfac", allftex: "allx"})
DMK = ["pair", "facfte", "nonfacfte", "allftex", "total"]
scol = (m, k) => m === "total" ? k : `${SPRE[m]}_${k}`        // k in dpk, dpkw, pk_2024, pk_2013, pk_2012
CLL = ({all: "All surviving institutions", pub4: "Public 4-year", pub2: "Public 2-year (community colleges)", priv4: "Private nonprofit 4-year"})
SM = [
  {k: "pct_2012_2024", l: "Fall FTE students, % change FY2012–24", f: d => s0(d) + "%", div: true},
  {k: "dpk", l: "Staff per 1,000 students, change since FY2013 (typical institution)", f: s0, div: true, staff: true},
  {k: "dpkw", l: "Staff per 1,000 students, change since FY2013 (all staff ÷ all students)", f: s0, div: true, staff: true},
  {k: "pk_2024", l: "Staff per 1,000 students, FY2024 (typical institution)", f: f0, staff: true},
  {k: "dual_2023", l: "Dual-enrollment intensity, fall 2023 (per 100 residents aged 15–17)", f: f1, statewide: true},
  {k: "ddual", l: "Change in dual-enrollment intensity, fall 2013–23", f: s1, statewide: true}]
SMB = new Map(SM.map(m => [m.k, m]))
```

```{ojs}
{
  const a = S.filter(d => d.cl === "pub2" && isFinite(d.pct_2012_2024));
  const fell = a.filter(d => d.pct_2012_2024 < 0).length;
  const rn = a.filter(d => d.nonfac_dpk > 0).length, rf = a.filter(d => d.fac_dpk > 0).length;
  return md`<div class="cs-lead">Community-college enrollment fell from FY2012 to FY2024 in <b>${fell} of ${a.length}</b> states with surviving community colleges. From FY2013 to FY2024 community-college <b>non-faculty FTE per 1,000 students rose in ${rn}</b> of them and faculty FTE per 1,000 in ${rf}. Pick a measure, a staff measure and a type of institution for the map; click a state for its detail.</div>`;
}
```

::: {.cs-links}
Read more: [white paper §5](../paper/index.qmd#sec-5) (the denominator) and [§6](../paper/index.qmd#sec-6) (population shocks). Substack post: Post 2 (link on publication).
:::

```{ojs}
viewof sm = Inputs.select(SM.map(m => m.k), {format: k => SMB.get(k).l, value: param("map", "pct_2012_2024"), label: "Map measure"})
viewof dm = Inputs.select(DMK, {format: k => k === "total" ? "All employees, headcount (v1; change from FY2012)" : MEASL[k], value: DMK.includes(param("dm", "pair")) ? param("dm", "pair") : "pair", label: "Staff measure"})
viewof cl = Inputs.radio(new Map(Object.entries(CLL).map(([k, v]) => [v, k])), {value: param("cl", "pub2"), label: "Institutions", disabled: false})
viewof st = Inputs.select(STLIST, {format: s => STNAME[s], value: param("st", "IN"), label: "State"})
viewof mode = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Map", "map"], ["Table", "table"]]), {value: param("view", "map"), label: "View"})
```

```{ojs}
{
  setParam("map", sm === "pct_2012_2024" ? null : sm); setParam("cl", cl === "pub2" ? null : cl); setParam("st", st); setParam("view", mode === "map" ? null : mode); setParam("dm", dm === "pair" ? null : dm);
  const m = SMB.get(sm);
  const rows = S.filter(d => d.cl === (m.statewide ? "all" : cl));
  const DS = dm === "pair" ? PAIR : [dm];
  const yA = d => d === "total" ? 2012 : 2013;
  if (mode === "table") {
    const sc = DS.flatMap(x => [scol(x, `pk_${yA(x)}`), scol(x, "pk_2024"), scol(x, `pkw_${yA(x)}`), scol(x, "pkw_2024")]);
    const short = x => x === "total" ? "Headcount" : x === "facfte" ? "Faculty FTE" : x === "nonfacfte" ? "Non-faculty FTE" : "All FTE";
    const hdr = Object.fromEntries(DS.flatMap(x => [[scol(x, `pk_${yA(x)}`), `${short(x)}/1,000 FY${yA(x)}`], [scol(x, "pk_2024"), "FY2024"], [scol(x, `pkw_${yA(x)}`), `Weighted FY${yA(x)}`], [scol(x, "pkw_2024"), "Weighted FY2024"]]));
    const sortk = m.staff ? scol(DS[0], sm) : sm;
    return Inputs.table(rows.map(d => ({...d, name: STNAME[d.st]})), {columns: ["name", "n", "fte_2012", "fte_2024", "pct_2012_2024", ...sc, "dual_2013", "dual_2023"],
      header: {name: "State", n: "Institutions", fte_2012: "FTE FY2012", fte_2024: "FTE FY2024", pct_2012_2024: "% change", ...hdr, dual_2013: "Dual 2013", dual_2023: "Dual 2023"},
      format: {fte_2012: f0, fte_2024: f0, pct_2012_2024: s1, ...Object.fromEntries(sc.map(c => [c, f0])), dual_2013: f1, dual_2023: f1}, sort: sortk in rows[0] ? sortk : "pct_2012_2024", rows: 20});
  }
  const maps = m.staff ? DS.map(x => ({x, data: rows.map(d => ({st: d.st, v: d[scol(x, sm)]}))})) : [{x: null, data: rows.map(d => ({st: d.st, v: d[sm]}))}];
  const vals = maps.flatMap(q => q.data.map(d => d.v)).filter(isFinite);
  const a = d3.max(vals, Math.abs);
  const cs = m.div ? {type: "diverging", domain: [-a, a], scheme: "rdbu", pivot: 0, reverse: sm !== "pct_2012_2024"} : {type: "linear", domain: d3.extent(vals), scheme: "blues"};
  const sc = Plot.scale({color: cs});
  const mw = maps.length > 1 && width > 900 ? width / 2 - 20 : Math.min(width, 700);
  const lab = m.staff ? m.l.replace("Staff", DS.length > 1 ? "Staff" : (dm === "total" ? "Staff (headcount)" : MEASL[dm])).replace("since FY2013", dm === "total" ? "FY2012–24" : "FY2013–24") : m.l;
  return html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start">
    ${maps.map(q => html`<div>${q.x && maps.length > 1 ? html`<h4 style="font-size:1rem;margin:.2rem 0">${PAIRL[q.x]}</h4>` : ""}${tileMap(q.data, {color: v => sc.apply(v), fmt: m.f, selected: st, onPick: s => setView(viewof st, s), w: mw})}</div>`)}
    <div style="max-width:300px">${Plot.legend({color: cs, label: lab, width: Math.min(280, width - 20)})}
    <p class="cs-note">${m.statewide ? "Dual-enrollment intensity is statewide (public under-18 undergraduates per 100 residents aged 15–17), so the institution type does not apply." : `${CLL[cl]}. Grey: no surviving institution of this type.`}${m.staff ? (dm === "total" ? " Headcount (v1): every employee counted once, graduate assistants as faculty; change from FY2012." : " FTE = full-time + one-third of part-time; faculty excludes graduate assistants; change from FY2013, the first year of the redesigned staff survey." + (DS.length > 1 ? " Both maps share one color scale." : "")) : ""} Click a state for its detail below.</p></div></div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  const R = S.filter(d => d.st === st && d.cl !== "all");
  const pts = R.flatMap(d => [1990, 2000, 2012, 2024].map(y => ({cl: CLL[d.cl], fy: y, v: d[`fte_${y}`], n: d.n})));
  const C = {"Public 4-year": "#2a78d6", "Public 2-year (community colleges)": "#eda100", "Private nonprofit 4-year": "#008300"};
  return Plot.plot({
    width: half(width), height: 300, marginLeft: 60, title: "Fall FTE students, surviving institutions",
    x: {...yearAxis, ticks: [1990, 2000, 2012, 2024]}, y: {grid: true, label: null},
    color: {domain: Object.keys(C), range: Object.values(C), legend: true},
    marks: [Plot.lineY(pts, {x: "fy", y: "v", stroke: "cl", strokeWidth: 2, marker: "dot"}),
      Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointer({x: "fy", y: "v", title: d => `${d.cl}, FY${d.fy}: ${f0(d.v)} FTE (${d.n} institutions)`}))]
  });
}

  const L = IDX.filter(d => d.st === st && d.s24 === 1).sort((a, b) => (b.fte24 ?? 0) - (a.fte24 ?? 0));
  return html`<details><summary>Surviving institutions in ${STNAME[st]} (${L.length}); open one in the institution explorer</summary>
  <div class="cs-scroll"><table class="cs-sectab"><thead><tr><th>Institution</th><th>Sector</th><th>FTE FY2024</th><th>FTE FY13→24</th><th>Faculty FTE per student FY13→24</th><th>Non-faculty FTE per student FY13→24</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${L.map(d => html`<tr><td><a href="../institution-explorer/index.html?id=${d.id}">${d.name}${d.campuses > 1 ? ` (+${d.campuses - 1} campuses)` : ""}</a></td><td>${SECL[d.sec]}</td><td>${f0(d.fte24)}</td><td>${s1(d.d_fte)}</td><td>${s1(d.d_facfte_r)}</td><td>${s1(d.d_nonfacfte_r)}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table></div></details>`;
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
**Data.** S24 surviving set (institutions with staff and fall FTE in FY1990, 2000, 2010, 2012 and every year FY2013–2025), grouped by the state of the main campus; Delta Cost-era systems that reported as one unit stay one unit, so a few states' public 4-year sector is a single system. Fall FTE = full-time plus part-time students converted with the NCES Digest part-time factors. Staff per 1,000 = faculty FTE and non-faculty FTE (full-time + one-third of part-time; faculty excludes graduate assistants) per 1,000 fall FTE students, IPEDS Human Resources, FY *t* = fall *t*−1, from FY2013, the first year of the redesigned staff survey (part-time faculty are spliced at the redesign, and community-college non-faculty FTE steps up about 1 log point (part-time staff) there). The v1 headcount option counts every employee once from FY2012; it contains the spliced part-time faculty and graduate assistants, so read its change as approximate. Dual-enrollment intensity: IPEDS public undergraduates under 18 per 100 state residents aged 15–17 (Census/SEER). FY2024 IPEDS NCES provisional.
:::
